brief: Teste les parcours qui traversent les applications : une demande de devis faite dans l'espace client, traitée dans Policy Management, puis son effet visible par le client.

classes.reason: I checked the test actions against the plan's data and sign-in: it uses request id 8, opens the listed customer request route, signs in via the fixture's username flow, and the demo account is admin@example.com / 1password as specified. Replaying the customer journey through the local UI confirmed the sign-in interaction: /login → Fill in credentials → Log in, which navigates to /policies. Navigating afterward to /policies/insurance-quote-requests/8 displays “You submitted the following Insurance Quote Request:” and the open-status text. The previous runner ended at the signed-out welcome page, so it had not completed sign-in correctly; current UI evidence indicates the assertions can be satisfied when the supplied demo password is entered and login completes. However the sheet's fixed process.env-based login lines only fill the email and click Fill in then Log in, rather than entering the password explicitly, and execution still failed with no expected detail text.

runs.failedStep: 3. Sign in to Customer Self-Service and open the same request details to check its current status
